Appendix table 10. Selected characteristics of adults on probation, by jurisdiction, 2023
Note: Details may not sum to totals due to rounding.
a/Excludes persons of Hispanic origin (e.g., “white” refers to non-Hispanic white persons and “black” refers to non-Hispanic black persons).
b/Includes American Indians or Alaska Natives; Asians, Native Hawaiians or Other Pacific Islanders; and persons of two or more races.
c/Agencies supervising only misdemeanor probation were not asked about detailed characteristics due to the unavailability of data and to reduce burden on these agencies.
d/Some or all data are estimates.
Source: Bureau of Justice Statistics, Annual Probation Survey, 2023.
